decisions.mark: distinguishes the two ways to substitute an allocator — a COMPILE-time pair of macros versus a RUNTIME pair of function pointers — and states that they are mutually exclusive
decisions.detail: QUOTE: "**Option A: compile time (zero overhead).** In the user config, enable `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_C`, `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY`, and define both `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_CALLOC_MACRO=my_calloc` and `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_FREE_MACRO=my_free`." and "`platform.c:16-19` says the compile-time macros take precedence, and when both are defined the runtime setter is compiled out entirely." | WHY: The answer distinguishes the compile-time macro pair from the runtime function-pointer setter, and says that defining the macros compiles the runtime setter out, which makes the two mutually exclusive. || QUOTE: **Option A: compile time (zero overhead).** In the user config, enable `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_C`, `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_MEMORY`, and define both `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_CALLOC_MACRO=my_calloc` and `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_FREE_MACRO=my_free`. ... **Option B: runtime.** ... call `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free(my_calloc, my_free)` ... `platform.c:16-19` says the compile-time macros take precedence, and when both are defined the runtime setter is compiled out entirely. | WHY: The answer separates the compile-time macro pair from the runtime function-pointer setter, and says that defining the macros compiles the runtime setter out entirely, which makes the two mutually exclusive. || QUOTE: **Option A: compile time (zero overhead).** ... define both `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_CALLOC_MACRO=my_calloc` and `MBEDTLS_PLATFORM_FREE_MACRO=my_free`. ... **Option B: runtime.** ... call `mbedtls_platform_set_calloc_free(my_calloc, my_free)` ... `platform.c:16-19` says the compile-time macros take precedence, and when both are defined the runtime setter is compiled out entirely. | WHY: The answer separates the compile-time macro pair from the runtime function-pointer setter and says that defining the macros compiles out the setter, so the two are mutually exclusive.
